The paramount purpose of regulation through licensing is, inter alia, to set in motion vigilant medical watch over the proper protection of drugs and medicines and the verification of the expiry of their life and the spuriousness of the products. If godowns, temporary stores and depots can remain unlicensed, they escape official attention and can deteriorate into foci of dubious or deceptive drugs harmful to society. Every place where storage for sale is made must be licensed.
